data.title: E-Skimmer Script Injection on Payment Pages
data.description: Detects unauthorized JavaScript injection on e-commerce payment pages by identifying Content Security Policy violations, unexpected external script loads from newly registered domains, and unauthorized Google Tag Manager container modifications. Magecart-style e-skimmer operators inject malicious scripts through CMS exploitation, compromised third-party libraries, or GTM container abuse. The "Sniffer by Fleras" MaaS platform accounts for 26% of all infections, and GTM container abuse has become a primary delivery vector due to GTM's trusted status in most CSP configurations. PCI DSS 4.0 Requirement 6.4.3 mandates automated script integrity monitoring on payment pages, making this detection a compliance requirement as well as a security control.

detection.condition: selection_csp or (selection_script_load and not filter_authorized_scripts) or selection_gtm_modification

enrichment_required.source: WHOIS enrichment (domain registration date for script origins)

falsepositives: Legitimate third-party marketing or analytics script deployments not yet added to the CSP whitelist
Authorized GTM container updates that were not pre-registered in the change management system
A/B testing platforms injecting scripts on checkout pages as part of authorized experiments
